1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein said fins and said light emitting diodes are disposed along a length of said columnar body such that light emitted from said light emitting diodes is directed substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of said columnar body__.

2. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __to ambient air__.

3. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, __said optic element being disposed between adjacent fins__.

4. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material.

5. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __with at least one diode residing on each face of the columnar body__.

6. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __such that one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body__.

7. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section, __the cross-section being polygonal with substantially straight side walls__.

8. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body, __and said lamp further includes a fin at each corner of said columnar body__.

9. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body, __each said fin extending radially from the corresponding corner__.

10. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __between adjacent fins__.

11. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, __and wherein said columnar body and said fins are integral__.

12. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 including a single optic element __disposed between each adjacent fin and__ over-lapping said diode.

13. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base, __and closes said first end of said columnar body__.

14. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current, __said printed circuit board being disposed within said hollow columnar body__.

15. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body, __between adjacent fins__.

16. (Currently amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, __wherein said light emitting diodes are positioned to emit light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of said body__.

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode, __wherein said elongated hollow body is a polygonal body having substantially straight side walls and a plurality of integral radially extending fins__.

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK.

19. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and is polygonal in cross-section__.
